## Pepparkaka

Original recipe from Grandma who gave it to Mom.  Dad would make the dough and Mom would bring it to the cookie bake. 

I often make a half-batch. 

### Ingredients:

- &frac12; lb butter (2 sticks); leave out to soften at room temperature, I prefer [earth balance](https://s3.amazonaws.com/grocery-project/product_images/earth-balance-buttery-sticks-56012-12906496.jpg)
- 1&frac12; cup sugar 
- 1 TBSP maple syrup 
- 1 flax egg (1 TBSP flax, mix with 3 TBSP water, let sit for at least 15 min) 
- 3&frac14; cup flour, I prefer [Bob's Red Mill Gluten Free 1 to 1 Baking Flour](https://d2lnr5mha7bycj.cloudfront.net/product-image/file/large_b48ea69e-20fe-4a73-b76f-94bc6bc8da7b.png)
- 2 tsp baking soda 
- 3 tsp cinnamon 
- 3 tsp cloves 
- 3 tsp ginger
- zest of 1 orange rind
- fresh orange juice from 1 orange (&frac14 cup) 
- [parlsocker (Swedish pearl sugar)](https://larsown.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/85000_01-1024x1024.jpg) -- get get at Lunds and Byerlys or Kowalskis 



### Directions 


**Dough** 

- make flax egg, set aside 
- zest orange rind and squeeze orange juice, set aside 
- sift dry ingredients together (excluding sugar), set aside 
  * flour 
  * baking soda 
  * cinnamon/cloves/ginger
- cream butter and sugar
  * after butter is room temperature and soften 
  * use fork to mix with sugar 
- add syrup and flax egg, mix
- add dry ingredients, mix 
- add orange zest and juice, mix 
- put dough on a piece of parchment paper and wrap up, put into air tight container and put into fridge -- leave overnight or at least for 4 hours 

**Bake**

- roll out on back of wooden cutting board
- need to use a lot of flour so it doesn't stick 
- roll out very thin and put onto baking sheet covered with parchment paper 
- sprinkle with pearl sugar and use little spoon to lightly press into dough 
- bake at 325F for 8-9 minutes
